summary: TWO BED TERRACE Located in the popular Denes area of Darlington, within walking distance to the hospital, local shops and amenities. Ideal for a single person or couple. Property comprises of - entrance vestibule, fitted kitchen with electric oven, breakfast bar. utility area. To the first floor are two bedrooms, one large double bedroom and single second bedroom/study, shower room with WC. Private yard to the rear
description: A beautifully presented two-bedroom mid-terraced property, newly refurbished throughout and offering modern, comfortable accommodation in a convenient Darlington location. The property has been refurbished to provide a fresh and contemporary living environment, making it an ideal home for a couple, small family or professional tenants. The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance, spacious reception/living room, and a modern fitted kitchen providing a practical and stylish space for everyday living. To the first floor are two well-proportioned bedrooms and a contemporary family bathroom. Having been newly refurbished throughout, the property offers a clean, modern and move-in-ready home. Further benefits include double glazing and central heating. Located on Chandos Street, Darlington, the property is conveniently positioned for access to local shops, amenities, schools, public transport links and Darlington town centre, with excellent road connections to the surrounding areas.
